author: HEMALI CHHAPIA
description: IIT-Bombay’s senate has halted new penalties for academic misconduct, reverting to the 2015 policy for upcoming examinations. This decision follows the recent death of a student suspected of cheating during an exam. An interim procedure allows faculty to document suspected dishonesty while encouraging student accounts on a separate form. Faculty members and students will present their cases before a disciplinary committee after the examination period.

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Moishe Mana has finalized the impressive sale of his Mana Wynwood properties to Ken Griffin for around $1.1 billion. This pivotal transaction will enable the development of a Carnegie Mellon University campus in Wynwood, set to welcome over 3,500 students and nearly 300 faculty members once operational. Construction is anticipated to start in 2027, with plans for student recruitment in forthcoming years.
title: Miami land assembled over 16 years sells for $1.1bn, university campus planned

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A team of researchers from Florida Atlantic University discovered that wild blacktip sharks possess the ability to detect low-frequency sounds from considerable distances. This groundbreaking study sheds light on how these sharks navigate their aquatic environments, as they exhibited keen directional hearing by making sharp turns in response to sound sources.
title: Blacktip sharks can hear sounds nearly 250 feet away and pinpoint the source

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: A luxurious Beverly Hills mansion was recently sold for $35 million after being on the market for four months. Originally listed at $75 million, the price was reduced significantly due to lack of buyers despite its celebrity ownership history. The estate features a main residence, a guest house, and various recreational amenities including a tennis court and children's playground.
title: Ricky Martin’s former Beverly Hills estate sells for $35m after major price cuts

author: RAJ SHEKHAR JHA AND VIBHOR MOHAN
description: A set of WhatsApp chats has emerged, alleging monetary transactions involving senior Punjab government officials and DSPs. CBI's dossier includes these chats as they prepare to interrogate CM Bhagwant Mann's OSD Rajbir Singh Ghuman. Allegations suggest that intermediaries received bribes for influencing transfers and policy formulations affecting IAS and IPS officers. Additionally, documents indicate potential irregularities in real estate projects and the Greater Mohali Area Development Authority.
title: 'Cash-for transfers' WA chats part of CBI dossier on Mann OSD

author: REMA NAGARAJAN
description: Health and medical trips incurred the highest expenses in rural and urban areas during a one-year period. The average expenditure for these trips was notably higher in urban than rural areas. Pilgrimage travel accounted for the largest share of trips taken throughout the year. Accommodation and transport were significant expenditures for health and medical trips, underscoring their financial impact.

author: SACHIN PARASHAR
description: India and Canada are currently engaged in the fifth round of talks for a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement. Both countries aim to sign the CEPA during Prime Minister Modi's anticipated visit to Canada. The visit is tentatively scheduled for December 11-13, just before the G20 summit in Florida. Leaders from both nations envision boosting bilateral trade to CAD 70 billion by 2030.
title: With PM Modi set to visit Ottawa, India & Canada back CEPA

description: Mumtaz Begum, a woman expelled to Bangladesh, remains untraceable by her family despite official claims of her safety. Her son, Momruz Ali, is pleading for government assistance to locate her in either country. The Gauhati High Court directed authorities to find Mumtaz and provide interim compensation to her husband. Reports indicate that searches in Bangladesh yielded no results for her whereabouts so far.

description: The Reserve Bank of India has announced a 25 basis points increase in the repo rate to 5.5%. This decision reflects growing inflation pressures and stronger than anticipated economic growth. The rise in interest rates will lead to higher loan EMIs, impacting consumption during the festive season. Banks are expected to increase fixed deposit rates following this policy change.

description: A special NIA court in Jammu has declared Nazir Hussain a proclaimed offender regarding grenade seizures. Hussain, originally from Hari village, is believed to be hiding in Pakistan currently. The court noted that previous non-bailable arrest warrants could not be executed due to his absence from home. Additionally, multiple attempts to compel Hussain to surrender have been unsuccessful.
title: Grenade seizure case: Pakistan-based ultra declared ‘proclaimed offender’

description: A thrift-store shopper who paid just $1.50 for a clutch in 2018 or 2019 discovered years later that it was a rare Cartier Art Deco piece. During a 2026 "Antiques Roadshow" appraisal, experts identified precious stones, platinum and the Cartier name inside, valuing the purse at about $35,000, with an insurance value above $100,000.

He believes this reflects an undervaluation of Indian culinary traditions compared to European cuisine. The restaurant has a significant historical background with notable patrons, including Indian leaders. The Crown Estate maintains its decision is based on structural issues and not culinary bias.

description: CUET-UG 2027 may implement notable changes to streamline the examination experience for students. Candidates could see a reduction in the number of subjects from five to four over time. author: KUMAR RAKESH
description: PM Narendra Modi delivered a speech highlighting his 25 years in government and the goal of developed India by 2047. He called upon citizens to commit to this ambitious target and emphasized the power of the people. Modi reiterated the importance of extraordinary goals, linking good governance to societal inclusion. He reflected on his journey from humble beginnings to leadership in the BJP.
title: 'We'll do it': PM Modi gives slogan for 2047 goals

description: Opposition members from the INDIA bloc attempted to stage a protest demanding the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar. They were detained by Delhi Police less than a kilometer from their protest site at Jantar Mantar. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge organized the lunch gathering, where the protest plan was discussed. Difficulties in moving their buses led to further confrontations with police as they sought to demonstrate.
title: Anti-CEC protests: Oppn, police face off again; Rahul says won’t stop till Gyanesh quits

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Now listed for $180 million, Turkey Track Ranch encompasses 77,721 acres of breathtaking terrain. With a lineage connected to essential battles and over a hundred years of family ownership, this sale is a unique opportunity to own a remarkable piece of history.

author: SANJAY KHAJURIA
description: Ladakh has commenced India's first high-altitude wildlife safari that highlights snow leopard trails and community involvement. Vinai Kumar Saxena, the lieutenant governor, emphasized the importance of coexisting wildlife and development. The Snow Leopard and High-Altitude Nature Conservation Society is coordinating this project with local forest departments. The mapped safari routes traverse significant wildlife areas, including Hemis National Park and Changthang.
title: India’s first high-altitude snow leopard safari flagged off in Ladakh

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Texas appeals court ruled that Allegiant Resources can access McFaddin Ranch to plug an inactive well. The dispute centers around the Remora Oil Unit No. 1 located near the San Antonio River. Virginia L. Dierlam, the ranch owner, previously secured a permanent injunction that limited access to the ranch. Allegiant argues that plugging the well is necessary to avoid environmental concerns, which the court acknowledged.

description: A Jammu NIA court rejected the bail application of Shabir Ahmad Shah, linked to a 30-year-old mob violence case. This case relates to violence during a terrorist's funeral procession in Srinagar, which Shah allegedly incited. The court expressed concern about potential threats to national security and the safety of protected witnesses. Shah argued that the investigation was reopened without justification and emphasized delays in legal actions.

description: PM Narendra Modi emphasized the importance of maritime connectivity and proposed a ceasefire plan for the Black Sea. His vision promotes cooperation and mutual benefit among nations to ensure maritime security. Chief of Naval Staff Admiral Krishna Swaminathan highlighted the interconnectedness of national security and economic security. He urged for collective action among regions to tackle maritime threats effectively.

description: Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce are facing continued legal pressure over their Kansas City steakhouse, 1587 Prime. The incident took place during the early hours of October 4, when two groups clashed in the parking area. The woman alleged that men in a car tried to abduct her and attacked her friends with hockey sticks. Police collected evidence, including blood samples, while no arrests were made so far.
title: Mercedes, 5-star hotel, hockey sticks: Nagaland woman's Delhi night out turns violent

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Gautam Gambhir expressed his gratitude to Ajit Agarkar after Agarkar's tenure as chief selector ended. During Agarkar's time, India achieved significant success in ICC tournaments, including three trophy victories. Pragyan Ojha has been appointed interim chairman of selectors while the BCCI invites applications for a permanent replacement. VVS Laxman will be present at future selection meetings to improve communication with the Centre of Excellence.
title: ‘History will be kinder to you’: Gautam Gambhir bids farewell to Ajit Agarkar

title: ‘We will do it’: PM Modi gives new slogan for Viksit Bharat, self-reliant India by 2047

author: MAYUR SHETTY
description: In a notable move, the Reserve Bank of India has adjusted the repo rate, increasing it by 25 basis points to 5.50%. This adjustment comes in response to stronger-than-anticipated economic growth alongside rising price pressures. Additionally, the RBI has updated its FY27 GDP growth prediction to 7.1%, indicating optimistic economic performance. Meanwhile, inflation forecasts have been revised upwards, predicting Consumer Price Index inflation to hover around 5.8%.
title: RBI raises interest rates, hikes FY27 growth forecast by 40 bps and inflation by 20 bps

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: Jaguar has introduced the Type 01, a new all-electric four-door grand tourer, which will begin production in 2027. This model utilizes Jaguar's dedicated Electric Architecture and features a tri-motor powertrain. It is expected to deliver up to 1,030 PS and provide an EPA range of up to 643 kilometers. The car offers a four-seat cabin with advanced display technology and unique audio features.
title: Jaguar Type 01 unveiled: 1,016 hp electric GT with 643 km range

description: US vice president JD Vance emphasized that Iran needs to make significant reductions in enrichment capacity. Vance highlighted the necessity of actionable commitments rather than mere promises for negotiations. The US is uncertain about Iran's internal decision-making process, especially after recent significant events. As the conflict continues, it poses political challenges for the Trump administration ahead of the midterm elections.
title: 'Why 60% enriched fuel?' Vance demands Iran cut nuclear capacity to end war

author: VINEET RAMAKRISHNAN
description: From a stand-in captain in 2012 to India's first women's ODI World Cup-winning skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur's 14-year captaincy produced 211 matches, 126 wins and eight title or gold-medal finishes. It also brought repeated questions over her leadership, batting and record against Australia. Her resignation closes a captaincy era that delivered the trophy India had waited for, while leaving the T20 World Cup and a long-running succession debate finally resolved.
title: Harmanpreet's captaincy: 211 matches, one WC and a debate that never went away

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Oracle has donated $10 million to the Nashville Symphony, saving the jobs of 77 musicians and 27 full-time staffers days before furloughs were due to begin. The gift matches the symphony's $10 million operating deficit and allows its 2026/27 season to resume through June 2027. Symphony CEO Mark Tillinger called the donation a profound vote of confidence, while Oracle CEO Clay Magouyrk said the company is here to help Nashville.
title: Why Oracle, as Nashville's orchestra ran out of cash, wrote it a $10m cheque

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a significant ruling, a Texas appeals court has granted Allegiant Resources the right to enter McFaddin Ranch to seal an inactive well. This decision comes in response to environmental concerns linked to the well’s proximity to the San Antonio River. Earlier access via another ranch was lost, emphasizing the intricate regulatory landscape governing inactive oil wells and the access issues surrounding private land ownership.
title: Texas court lets oil company cross 1,604-acre ranch to plug shut-in well

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison is preparing to relist his 8.4-acre oceanfront estate in North Palm Beach for $165 million. He bought the property for $80 million in 2021 and had initially planned to tear down the existing house. The estate was previously offered for $145 million and includes a 16,300-square-foot home with extensive ocean frontage.
title: Larry Ellison bought Florida estate for $80m; 5 years later, it lists for $165m

description: The man had been employed in Aurangabad. During FY 2018-19, his employer shut down its Aurangabad plant and introduced a financial scheme for its employees. The man opted for voluntary retirement under the scheme and received a total payment of Rs 65,21,105. The amount consisted of ex-gratia/severance pay, early bid and group participation incentives, and payment towards the notice period.

author: KALYAN DAS
description: Ramesh Kapoor, his wife Rajni, and their house help Tilya Devi were found murdered in Dehradun. The couple had an argument with plumber Raj Kumar over payment for work done. During the altercation, Raj Kumar attacked the couple and fatally stabbed Tilya Devi when she intervened. A screwdriver was recovered at the crime scene and is believed to be the murder weapon.
title: 'They paid Rs 300 only': How payment dispute turned deadly for elderly couple

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes have made children a major focus of their charitable work through the 15 and the Mahomies Foundation. Their efforts include a $1.625 million Boys & Girls Clubs commitment, a $1 million inclusive Kansas City playground, literacy programs reaching more than 20,000 students, community grants and food support for families facing hardship.
title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ $1.6M philanthropy: How are they helping 20,000 kids?

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
description: A woman at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Siberia reportedly died from pneumonia of unknown cause. While there are suggestions she may have contracted pneumonic plague, Russian authorities have not confirmed this diagnosis. The World Health Organisation assesses the risk of spreading beyond Russia as very low and is in contact with Russian officials. US President Donald Trump plans to discuss the case with Russian President Vladimir Putin soon.
title: 'Will call Putin over pneumonic plague,' says Trump - what is happening in Russia?

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: In a candid revelation, Jason Sanjay, son of the iconic Thalapathy Vijay, reflects on the trials of his college romance, which ultimately succumbed to long-distance challenges while he pursued studies abroad. Music became his solace during the emotional turbulence, particularly the melodies of Yuvan Shankar Raja. To respect his past relationship, Sanjay refrained from sharing sentimental posts on social media.
title: Jason Sanjay recalls college romance; Thalapathy Vijay's son opens up on breakup

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Despite their eagerness, many children struggle to stick to the schedules they create. This challenge often arises from a lack of self-regulation and necessary executive function skills. Research shows that cognitive processes can affect a child’s ability to recall and follow through with planned tasks. Parents should evaluate the feasibility of their child's plans and offer assistance to improve execution.
title: Kids love making timetables but struggle to follow them: Here's why

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Archaeologists have uncovered the remains of a 3,000-year-old young male horse inside Egypt’s ancient Abqaa’ fortress, suggesting it may have been used to pull a chariot. Nearby harness fittings point to its military role. Excavations also uncovered tablets bearing the names of Ramesses II and Merneptah, along with a depiction of a captured Libyan prisoner from the Meshwesh tribe.
title: 3,000-year-old horse found in Egyptian fort linked to Ramesses II

description: The push for making Daylight Saving Time permanent is gaining momentum in the U.S., bolstered by President Trump. Nevertheless, this move is met with pushback because of health-related concerns brought to light by recent studies. Experts warn that this change could interfere with natural circadian rhythms, posing potential health risks.
title: As the US govt wants to change the clock 'forever', researchers in Canada warn

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Lionel Messi’s emotional Argentina farewell ended in a 3-0 victory over Benin at the Monumental. After an extraordinary pre-match tribute, Messi assisted Nicolás Otamendi’s opener and Nico Paz’s curling finish before scoring a penalty himself. He came close again late on, hitting the post, before sending a final free-kick over the bar as Argentina celebrated a memorable night.
title: Messi's emotional farewell ends in 1 goal, 2 assists and 3-0 win for Argentina

author: MIHIR TANKSALE
description: Abhay Marathe, a 33-year-old lawyer, was found dead from a bullet injury in Lonavla. His family initially claimed the shooting was accidental while he cleaned his grandfather's rifle. However, police investigation revealed inconsistencies and evidence of a dispute over property. Abhay's grandfather Motiram Marathe has been charged with murder, and four relatives are accused of destroying evidence.
title: Grandfather shoots lawyer grandson dead: How blood splatters exposed killing

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Eva Marie Saint, the acclaimed actress famed for her iconic role in ‘On the Waterfront’, has sadly passed away at her Los Angeles residence, surrounded by her loving family. Born on July 4, 1924, in Newark, New Jersey, she was raised in Albany and Delmar, New York. Throughout her illustrious career, Saint captivated audiences with her performances in numerous films and television series, earning a multitude of prestigious awards.
title: 'North by Northwest' star Eva Marie Saint passes away at 102

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: ‘Drishyam 3’ has earned Rs 216.50 crore net in India in five days, with Rs 19 crore on Tuesday. Ajay Devgn's thriller opened at a career-best Rs 62 crore, has doubled the original's lifetime total, and sits about Rs 30 crore short of Drishyam 2's Rs 239.67 crore record.
title: Drishyam 3 crosses Rs 216 cr in 5 days, nears Drishyam 2 record

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Christa Pike, a death row inmate in Tennessee, is recovering at a hospital following a failed execution attempt. Her lawyers reported that she is awake and speaking after being unconscious for several days. Doctors say the extent of her recovery remains uncertain, and she might face a long rehabilitation process. Legal questions arise about whether Tennessee can execute her again after the failed lethal injection.
title: 'Against all odds': Tennessee death row inmate Christa Pike awake after failed execution

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Rising oil prices, now exceeding 1%, raise alarms over potential storm disruptions affecting U.S. oil production and refineries. With Brent crude passing $101 per barrel and WTI crude hitting $90.38, concerns are amplified by supply issues from Saudi Arabia and mixed signals on U.S. inventories. Coupled with ongoing tensions between Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis, analysts predict sustained high prices unless significant diplomatic progress is made.
title: Brent crosses $101 as Saudi attacks, US storm add to oil supply concerns

author: SOROR SHAIZA
description: Cristiano Ronaldo has revealed why he left Portugal’s camp, claiming Jorge Jesus broke promises over his playing time and then contradicted their private agreement publicly. Ronaldo said the situation left him feeling unwanted and that continuing would harm the team. He apologised for leaving, accepted responsibility for his actions and insisted he remains available to compete for Portugal after his suspension.
title: Ronaldo Explains Portugal Exit: Star details broken promises; vows return

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s privacy fence for their $5.35 million Ohio mansion has been approved despite neighbors’ concerns about Lake Erie views, landscaping and a shared sewer line. The approximately 1,190-foot fence will sit two feet inside the boundary of the couple’s 3.5-acre lakefront property and feature two gates providing access to sewer manholes.
title: Swift-Kelce's $5.35M Ohio mansion privacy fence approved

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: In 1987, Canadian scientists discovered ancient glass sponge reefs alive in British Columbia’s Hecate Strait, overturning the belief that these reef-building animals had vanished 40 million years ago. More than 9,000 years old, the reefs survive today in Hecate Strait, Queen Charlotte Sound and Howe Sound, creating a rare underwater ecosystem often called the “Sea of Glass.”
title: 40M-year-old glass sponge reefs found alive off B.C. after thought extinct

author: RAJEEV DIKSHIT
description: A woman from Varanasi, aged 25, has leveled allegations against her husband and in-laws for concealing his HIV positive status. The revelation came post-marriage in 2024, triggering harassment and violence from her in-laws, who persisted in demanding dowry despite her protestations. After enduring threats, she sought police help, and her complaint was filed on October 3, following initial reluctance to act on her case.
title: Varanasi woman 'thrashed' after finding husband HIV+; alleges rape bid by father-in-law

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: The extraordinary migration of monarch butterflies stretches across thousands of miles, connecting North America and Mexico. Sadly, their population has sharply declined, prompting the International Union for Conservation of Nature to mark them as endangered. Key threats include habitat loss, pesticide usage, and climate change, which disproportionately impact their crucial milkweed supply. To aid these delicate creatures, conservation efforts are imperative, with U.S. federal protection still pending.
title: Meet Monarchs: ‘Endangered’ traveller butterflies that survive on poisonous milkweed

author: TNN
description: The GST Council intends to shorten the refund processing period to around 17 days for businesses. It will also work to automate registering for a GST number to speed up the process. For small businesses operating in multiple states, avoiding repetitive registrations will be considered. Additionally, the proposal includes eliminating physical verification for registration cancellations. Changes will allow input tax credit on various business-related expenses to facilitate smoother operations.
title: Most GST refunds may be processed within 17 days

author: TNN
description: In the upcoming Rajya Sabha elections, all 10 candidates from BJP and Samajwadi Party are set to be elected unopposed. Samajwadi Party decided against fielding a third candidate, eliminating the possibility of a contest. The BJP is positioned to secure all eight available seats due to its majority in the Assembly. The results will be formally declared after the nomination scrutiny concludes on October 9.
title: All 10 Rajya Sabha candidates from UP set to get elected unopposed

description: Two candidates participating in the UP Police constable recruitment physical tests collapsed and died in hospital. Vivek Kumar from Shamli and Atul Kumar from Mathura were among the candidates. Both candidates reportedly experienced severe health issues during the 4.8km run required for male applicants. Officials are investigating the circumstances surrounding their deaths while autopsy reports are awaited.
title: Two candidates die during police constable recruitment run, heart attack suspected

author: TUSHAR TERE
description: A man named Rajesh Ninama and a 16-year-old girl ended their lives in Dahod district. They livestreamed the act on Instagram, leaving viewers horrified and their families devastated. Rajesh had approached his parents for permission to marry the girl, but they refused due to clan differences. Following this rejection, the couple decided to take their own lives in a forested area.
title: Teen couple commit suicide on Instagram live in Dahod forest; family among viewers

author: BHARAT KHANNA
description: Amarinder Singh Mandofal, an AAP functionary, was duped into marrying a woman posing as a PCS officer. She concealed her previous marriage and departed with gold and cash, raising suspicion. Mandofal discovered her forged documents, including certificates and identification. Her family allegedly threatened him over a settlement due to concealed facts. Police have registered an FIR against the woman and five relatives while the investigation continues.
title: AAP neta claims wife posed as PCS officer, hid previous marriage, 18-year-old son

author: U SUDHAKAR REDDY
description: A BJP booth-level agent and others were booked for trying to remove 30 Muslim voters from electoral lists. The Chikkadpally police registered a case based on a complaint from the electoral registration officer. Following a verification exercise, officials confirmed that all 30 voters resided at their recorded addresses. Political leaders are now calling for a broader investigation into the incident.
title: BJP booth agent booked over bid to delete 30 Mulsim voters
